long_biography.plain_text:
When her husband's death dissolved their marital-property community in 2017, María Luisa del Río entered a complex succession with their six adult children. A later division assigned her 51 properties, water-use rights, corporate interests and other assets. She then sought to transfer selected holdings equally among the children while retaining financial security.

That portfolio sat alongside a long-standing stake in the family company behind El Mercurio. Publicly known as Malú, del Río also took part in Chilean cultural organizations and maintained archival correspondence with artist Nemesio Antúnez. She had married Agustín Edwards Eastman in Santiago and remained his wife for more than six decades. Del Río died in August 2023, aged 93.
